issues.description: SealSaloon API naming is inconsistent: the problem statement/UML requires a (static) method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal): int, but the solution implements the corresponding functionality as computeMealCost(Meal): int. Students following the statement will implement/call calculateTotalPrice, while the reference code (and any code based on it) uses computeMealCost, causing confusion and potential test/compilation mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename SealSaloon.computeMealCost(Meal) to calculateTotalPrice(Meal) (keeping it static) and update any call sites accordingly (e.g., Main.java comments/examples if applicable).
